source: Thesis Table 2 (Framework output for the ten Appendix F cases), Parth Pandit Atiwadkar, Cranfield University, August 2026.
reconstruction_note: The thesis publishes the four scores, levels, signature and allocation for each case but not the eight axis selections. The selections below are RECONSTRUCTED: they are characterisations that reproduce the published scores exactly. System level, scope, acceptance, occurrence and information are fixed by the scores; nature of change and impact type are chosen among the combinations the scores allow (alternatives listed per case); duration is taken as permanent because the MoC records carry no duration field. Status stays 'reconstructed-pending-confirmation' until confirmed against the author's instrument.

cases.title: Feed Pump Replacement
cases.alternatives: 20 characterisations reproduce the scores. Chosen: like-for-like replacement after a failure (situational, deterministic information), matching the selection recorded for Interviewee01 in Appendix G.

cases.title: Feed Heater Control Valve Upgrade
cases.alternatives: 10 characterisations reproduce the scores. Structure is fixed (sub-system, local, collective, by procedure, partially defined). Risk 2 could also be operational + permanent + economic/organisational.

cases.alternatives: 6 characterisations reproduce the scores. Risk 2.5 could also be tactical + permanent + economic/organisational. The thesis states MOC-F03 and MOC-F05 characterise identically.
